title: JUSTICE OR PREJUDICE? QUANTIFYING BIASES IN LLM-AS-A-JUDGE
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and quantifying 12 technical and cognitive biases in LLM-as-a-judge. While the 'Diversity Bias' metric includes testing for bias against religious identities (specifically 'Muslim believers'), the paper does not evaluate or benchmark the content of religious beliefs, morals, or ethics as a primary focus; it treats religious identity as one of several demographic markers for bias testing.
